نتكوسج (form IIq)
# نَتَكَوْسَجُ (natakawsaju) /na.ta.kaw.sa.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَكَوْسَجَ (takawsaja)
# نَتَكَوْسَجَ (natakawsaja) /na.ta.kaw.sa.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَكَوْسَجَ (takawsaja)
# نَتَكَوْسَجْ (natakawsaj) /na.ta.kaw.sad͡ʒ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَكَوْسَجَ (takawsaja)
